create_Owlv2Config: create an Owlv2Config instance with default text and vision sub-configs for the OWLv2 model
create_Owlv2TextConfig: create an Owlv2TextConfig instance with transformer text encoder defaults for OWLv2
create_Owlv2VisionConfig: create an Owlv2VisionConfig instance with vision encoder defaults for OWLv2
build_Owlv2Config_with_dict: build an Owlv2Config instance by passing text_config and vision_config as dictionaries
review_Owlv2Config_post_init: review the Owlv2Config __post_init__ method that initializes text and vision sub-configs from dicts or defaults
